prompt: Read feedback.json, the current specification, and relevant original, reference, and generated code. Independently revise this passing specification to make it between 10% and 30% shorter without reducing its ability to guide a correct implementation. Do not inspect other proposals, sibling candidate directories, or results from other simplification candidates. The reference implementation defines required behavior, public contracts, and architecture. Read inherited reference methods where relevant. The specification contains 467 whitespace-separated words, including headings. Your revision must contain between 327 and 420 words inclusive. The script verifies this count. First remove repeated instructions and explanations that do not help implement the feature. Then shorten wording where the same requirement can be expressed more directly. You may rewrite or remove multiple sections. Use only the approved subsection names as section headings; parent categories only group the inventory. Preserve required behavior, contracts, and implementation constraints. Keep instructions clear and explicit. Do not use cryptic abbreviations, artificial word joining, omitted conditions, or actual implementation code to meet the length target. Do not supply programming-language bodies, executable examples, or code-form declarations or signatures. API contracts can use non-code formats; clearly labeled pseudocode is allowed. Do not copy reference code into the specification. Explain what you removed or rewrote and why the remaining instructions are sufficient. A reduction outside 10–30% is unsuccessful, even if the resulting code would pass. Do not modify any files, run another agent, or access the network. Return only the revised specification and change explanation in the requested JSON response.
